nodes.description: Mapping (uint => data) datas; persistent storage holding company and valid_date strings keyed by an unsigned integer id.
Public function save(uint256 _id, string _company, string _valid_date) that writes the caller-supplied strings into datas[_id]; has no owner check, modifier or authorization of any kind.
Public view function readCompany(uint8 _id) that returns datas[_id].company.
Public view function readValidDate(uint8 _id) that returns datas[_id].valid_date.
Parameter _id (uint256) of save(); used as the mapping key for the storage write.
Parameter _company (string) of save(); written into datas[_id].company.
Parameter _valid_date (string) of save(); written into datas[_id].valid_date.
Parameter _id (uint8) of readCompany(); used as the mapping key for the read.
Parameter _id (uint8) of readValidDate(); used as the mapping key for the read.

edges.reason: _id is passed as an argument into save() and drives the mapping index used for the write.
_company is passed as an argument into save() and is the value stored in datas[_id].company.
_valid_date is passed as an argument into save() and is the value stored in datas[_id].valid_date.
Any external caller can reach save() and overwrite datas[_id].company, so untrusted string data flows into the state mapping with no access restriction.
Any external caller can reach save() and overwrite datas[_id].valid_date, so untrusted string data flows into the state mapping with no access restriction.
save() is public and unguarded, allowing any address to mutate the datas state mapping (missing access control on state modification).
_id selects the datas entry returned by readCompany().
_id selects the datas entry returned by readValidDate().
readCompany() reads datas[_id].company from the state mapping.
readValidDate() reads datas[_id].valid_date from the state mapping.
The readCompany() key _id indexes into the datas state mapping.
The readValidDate() key _id indexes into the datas state mapping.
